title: ACS DEFER Resolution
description: This object describes how and when a DEFER resolved. The resolution record of Specification 6.6 holds this object next to decision, the Guardian's final decision on the deferred step.

deferred_request_id.description: The request_id of the deferred step.

resolution_method.description: What resolved the deferral, which may differ from the resolution_method the DEFER expected in defer_details. 'timeout': the deferral was still pending at the Guardian's deadline of Specification 6.6, and the decision is 'deny'. 'session_end': the session ended while the deferral was pending, and the decision is 'deny'.

resolved_at.description: When the Guardian resolved the deferral.

deferred_metadata.description: The metadata of the deferred step, as the Guardian received it. This metadata holds the identity that the deferred step carried.

approval.description: The approver's answer. This object is required when resolution_method is 'human_approval' and absent otherwise. An approver's deny resolves to deny. After an approver's allow, the Guardian may set the final decision to deny, modify or ask, and reason_codes then name the cause (Specification 6.6).
